zh: 已接下这一单，完成后结束授权。
en: Accepted this order; permission ends with it.

zh: 不在菜田所在区域，暂时不能帮忙。

en: Very hungry; share a meal first.

zh: 等我忙完，不打断当前事情。
en: Busy; the current activity stays in place.

zh: 这片田没有可做的空格、缺水格或成熟作物。
en: No available empty, dry or ripe plots for this order.

zh: 仓库和本人背包的种子不够；没有开始。
en: Not enough seeds in storage and own backpack; nothing started.

zh: 田格已变化，请重新查看并确认。
en: Plots changed; review and confirm again.

zh: 这份农活确认已失效，请重新选择。
en: This farm plan is invalid; choose again.

zh: 只让勾选的伙伴接这一单；按现有种子分格，收成送进仓库。
en: Only selected companions take this order, using real seeds and depositing harvest in storage.

zh: 分给我的田格已种好并浇水。
en: My assigned plots are planted and watered.
